lines.text: Laplace! Cinderella!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Leave it to the hero!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: No holding back.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Stop. Its outer shell is too tough. Your attacks won't get through.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I'll help.
The air ripples, and torrents of water pour down, rushing into Gluttony's gaping maw as it lets out a monstrous shriek.
*Glug glug glug*
Gluttony's feeding organs swell, bulging like cheeks filled with water.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: This should be obvious, but Gluttony's stomach isn't bottomless.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: It chooses what it lets in.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Right now, most of its stomach is filled with water.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Since it doesn't need any more, it shuts its throat.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: And as you can see, its outer shell stretches easily.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Now, look closer. When the shell stretches from the water, it gets thinner.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Get to the point.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: We can cut through it now.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Cinderella! Mid-right section!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Glass Slippers. Full contact.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Cut it down.
The light from Cinderella's Glass Slippers condenses into a single point.
Dozens, then hundreds of rays merge into a single razor-sharp blade.
*Swish!*
With remarkably little noise, Gluttony is split clean in two.
The severed upper half thrashes wildly.
Behemoth grabs it with her pincers and throws it to Rapi.
Rapi uses her drill to pierce Gluttony's core,
after which Laplace dissolves the scattered fragments with her light.
The remains clinging to the ground quickly stiffen before crumbling to dust.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text:
It looks like they severed its feeding organs.
That means they won.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Incredible! Th-they brought it down so easily!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Levi!
Leviathan is still inside Little Mermaid's bubble.
Siren, if you would.
Little Mermaid takes a step forward.
The bubble lands on the ground gently.
Little Mermaid enters the bubble without hesitation.
Inside, she and Leviathan face each other.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Levi.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Siren.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Is your life full of light now?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Did you escape that dark cave?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I hope so,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: because you're a very dear friend to me.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Siren... I...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I ran away.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Even though I knew you'd die if I did.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I was scared. I didn't want to die.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You gave me everything, and I abandoned you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I betrayed you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'm a traitor.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: A filthy traitor.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That's how I was born. It's the only way I know how to live.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I have no idea what you're talking about, Levi.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'm a filthy traitor!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I abandoned the most precious thing in the world to me! I ran away!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'm so broken that I don't know how to live any oth—

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'm alive.
Little Mermaid swims forward in the bubble and gently takes Leviathan's hand.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Do you feel this?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's warm...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yes. Because I'm alive.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That means you're not a traitor,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: because you didn't betray me.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You never have. Not once.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: But... Siren.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I've lived such a pathetic life since then.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I didn't go searching for you because... I'm a traitor. That's just what I am.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You only told yourself that because you couldn't live with yourself otherwise.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That may be. But still, I missed our time together so much,

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: those days in the dark cave, and on that cloudy beach...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I missed them so much that I tried to meet new people and make new friends.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I tried to build a family.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You gave me everything, but I only thought of myself.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I didn't use the powers you gave me for good,

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I just used them for myself.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Along the way, I met people who wanted to talk with me.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: People I knew were good. Genuinely kind people.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I wanted to be with them, but I chose not to.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I betrayed them because that's who I am. I took advantage of their goodwill.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: My life isn't full of light.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I am still, and will continue to be,

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: curled up inside that dark cave, drenched in black water,

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: broken.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Levi, look behind you.
Leviathan slowly turns around.
Behemoth and Ziz are watching her.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Behemoth, Ziz...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Your life is full of light.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You're not broken.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You have people who love you.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You're doing it right, Levi. You're living a good life.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: So please, once and for all,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: forgive yourself.
Little Mermaid embraces Leviathan tightly.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'm so glad we were able to meet again.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: My dear friend.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: *Sob* Ah... ahhhh...!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'm so sorry, Siren! I'm so sorry...!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I messed up! I made a terrible mistake!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I missed you! I missed you so, so much...!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You, you mean more to me than anything...! You showed me how to live...!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You've been my light in the darkness...!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: My lantern...!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: *Sob* Waaaahh!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Levi...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'm sorry... I'm sorry... I'm sorry...!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It's okay! Everything is okay, Levi.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Oh!
*Thud*
Little Mermaid suddenly pushes Leviathan away.
Leviathan tumbles onto the ground.
She lifts her head and looks at Little Mermaid.
Little Mermaid looks at Leviathan and smiles.
*Chomp*
A gigantic mouth swallows Little Mermaid whole.
Ugh.
It's so loud.
Why's everyone screaming? You're making so much noise.

Can't you see Siren just get eaten by Gluttony? 
Be quiet.
Siren was alive. She held my hand and hugged me.
Gluttony, Gluttony, Gluttony...
That big, scary mouth... Big, and scary, and big, and scary...
That big, scary mouth... devours everything.
Trees, buildings, even the earth itself.
That big, scary mouth swallowed Siren.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Levi! Get back or you'll get eaten!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Siren! Siren!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I can't believe it just came out of the ground like that...!
*Bellow*
Gluttony opens its mouth again,
and Leviathan looks inside.
She sees nothing. Only darkness.
It... swallowed her. It swallowed her.
It swallowed Siren.
It pushed Siren back into the dark again.
You swallowed her again. You swallowed Siren.
My friend. My lantern.
The one who pulled me out of the darkness.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Give her back.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Give her back...!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Do you hear me?!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Give... Siren... baaaaack!
Black light erupts
from Leviathan's body.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: *Gasp!*

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: She's transforming!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Agghhhh!
Leviathan grabs Gluttony's jaws and forces them apart,
ready to rip them wide open.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Spit her out! Spit her out!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I said spit... her... out!
*Craaaack!*
*Rippppp!*

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Ahhhhh!
*Snap!*
Gluttony's upper jaw is torn free and sent flying.
Leviathan plunges her hand into Gluttony's lower jaw.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Siren! Siren!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Where did you go...?
Leviathan pulls her hand out,
and she slowly opens her lightly closed fist.
In her palm sits Little Mermaid,
who looks up at the giant Leviathan.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Siren...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You have such beautiful eyes, Levi.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Yeah.
Leviathan gently sets Little Mermaid down on the ground.
*Rumbleeeee*
From the ground, three maws rise.
They devour the buildings as they advance toward Leviathan.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Th-they're huge!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Wait here for a second.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'll be back after destroying them.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Behemoth, Ziz.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Sorry, but can you help?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I don't want those things swallowing the ones I care about ever again.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Let's go!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Yeah!
Black light bursts forward.
The three beasts, cloaked in dark flesh,
rush through the white city.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: That's... beautiful.
